Mindfulness-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Mindfulness marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Mindfulness workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

正念 vs 冥想 vs 呼吸

US pages use "Mindfulness", "Meditation", or "Breathe." China storefront copy often uses 正念 for the Mindfulness app ecosystem and mindful-minutes positioning, 冥想 when gallery frames show guided session libraries or course catalogs, and 呼吸 when Breathe inhale-exhale animations or breathing-timer UI dominate. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

Mindful Minutes vs Activity rings

Mindful Minutes (正念分钟) track mindfulness session duration — not move/exercise/stand Activity rings. When your gallery shows weekly mindful-minute totals or session streak badges, caption lines use 正念分钟 — not 活动闭环 unless the frame shows Fitness ring-close UI.

Reflect vs Journal vs State of Mind

Reflect (反思) is Apple's end-of-day mindfulness reflection surface — not Apple Journal long-form entries and not Health vitals charts. State of Mind (心理状态) covers mood and emotional wellbeing logging when your English listing leads with that workflow — folded on this page, not a separate mental-health SKU.

Breathe vs Background Sounds vs Sleep Wind Down

Breathe (呼吸) is guided inhale-exhale practice with haptic cues — not Background Sounds ambient rain loops and not Sleep Wind Down pre-bed routines unless your gallery actually shows those surfaces. Match caption vocabulary to the workflow your frame markets.

Meditation libraries vs Fitness mindful cooldown

Standalone meditation course catalogs and daily calm session pickers belong here. Mindful cooldown shown inside a Fitness workout finish after HIIT or strength training belongs on the Apple Fitness guide — not this page unless meditation libraries dominate your gallery.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Mindfulness-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 正念, 冥想, 呼吸, and 正念分钟 each signal different intent from generic 健康 wellness keywords or 睡眠 sleep terms.
